acceptance_criteria.description: The capability matrix and renderer live under tools rather than masquerading as one executable experiment bundle.
Standalone-verified reports retain native metrics, BMP metrics, usage, failures, and evidence links in JSON and HTML.
Focused tests and collaboration validation pass.

objective: Keep the cross-benchmark capability matrix and verified result renderer outside formal experiment bundles while preserving every emitted metric and unavailable cell.
title: Add verified memory baseline report tool
